wylie: [e73] gnyis pa ni, de ltar na sangs rgyas dang slob ma nyan thos rnams la thun mong du yod pa kun shes pa nyid kyi lam gyi rten can gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa bdun no
english: Which brings us finally to our second point: a summary of the general import.  Given the above explanations, we can say then that there are 37 different aspects that revolve around that “one knowledge about things” and which are shared by the Enlightened Ones with “students,” or listeners. Part Two: 34 aspects of path knowledge shared with the bodhisattvas
